The '''Kooda system''' was located in [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Koodan]]s.<ref name="Wizards" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kooda [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
